text:
alex: quick ping — traces got dropped from OTLP exporter during 3pm spike. backend returned 429 + GRPC RST_STREAM. Anyone seen this pattern?
maria: saw it in the alerts. queue backed up, exporter logs show `rpc error: code = Unavailable` then `http/2 stream reset`
ryan: what exporter mode/config are we using? grpc primary with http fallback or pure http? backoff settings?
alex: running grpc primary with http fallback. current config: backoff=exponential base=100ms max=60s, jitter=none, max_retries=5, max_inflight=32
sasha: no jitter is dangerous — synchronized retries -> thundering herd. we should add full jitter + per-instance seed
devon: also worth noting we treat 429 as retryable everywhere; downstream enforces per-tenant quotas so 429 often means we should back off much harder or drop low-value spans
maria: suggestion: classify 429 as throttle. use `Retry-After` header if present, otherwise exponential + full jitter and a longer max (30s -> 2min) for throttles
ryan: streaming grpc needs special care — reconnecting opens new stream and in-flight batches can get re-sent. we either need idempotency (sequence IDs) or hedging policies to avoid duplication
alex: we don't add any ids today. sequence ids per-batch seem implementable in exporter side; collector would need to optionally de-dupe
sasha: collector currently has no de-dupe layer. alternative is making retries conservative: at-most-once semantics by dropping spans older than N seconds when queue is overloaded
devon: concrete proposal: change exporter config -> grpc primary with: max_inflight=16, queue_size=5000, backoff.base=100ms, backoff.factor=2, backoff.max=30s, jitter=full, treat 429 as throttle with throttle_multiplier=5 (cap throttle_max=120s), and enable send_sequence_id=true
ryan: also add shutdown_grace config: drain queue for X seconds and only then close stream. current deploys trigger reconnect storms because we cut streams immediately
alex: can someone draft a config PR and run load tests simulating tenant-level 429 + h2 stream resets? I'll help run the traces/alerts check
sasha: I'll take the PR. will add unit tests for jitter distribution (to avoid accidentally using no-jitter), and a small e2e test that asserts we don't see synchronized retry spikes. will also add metrics: `exporter.retries.sync_count` and `exporter.duplicates_detected`
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: exporter-config-test -> staging at 2026-03-19T02:00Z :rocket:
maria: thanks. if drops persist after this config, next step is switching primary to http1 fallback with per-batch ack and stronger retention/backpressure on producer side
alex: noted. thanks everyone for the quick triage.
